item.text: I’ll read the three files once, then make one focused improvement in `algorithm.py` using a native patch.

The search couples each yaw change with a random position move, so a worse preferred distance can cause a useful rotation to be rejected. I’ll add a bounded distance correction to floor-object proposals, preserving their tangential movement and yaw variation. The query budget and final selection rule will stay unchanged.

Modified only `algorithm.py` to add bounded, relation-aware floor-position corrections that account for 3D centre height while preserving sampled yaw and tangential variation. Query budget and final selection remain unchanged.
